explanation: Pointing directly at a person with your index finger is generally seen as impolite and overly aggressive in Russia, similar to many European cultures, since it can feel accusatory rather than neutral. It's more acceptable to point at objects or directions than directly at a person.
local_tip: Gesture with an open hand or nod your head toward someone instead of pointing your index finger at them.

also_check.note: Pointing with the index finger at a person is considered very impolite; an open hand is used instead.
Pointing with the index finger is common and generally acceptable in casual settings.
Pointing with the index finger is considered impolite; the thumb is used instead.
